user_priority: Analyze then optimize. Avoid polishing errors already below useful0.5% scales; prioritize long-run history preservation and overall estimation effects.

practical_comparison_scales.meaning: Preferred application scales for query differences and point scoring, not uncertainty coverage or universal compressor certificates

repair: Replace barycentric SOC-grid deposition with continuously carried conditional means/variances. Preserve initial-SOC mixture identities, health/temperature/nuisance coupling and physical charge-path dependence.
approximation: Exact conditional first two moments for health-mixture transport, followed by first-order Gaussian OCV conditioning. Moment projection is explicit and checked against a continuous unmerged-path oracle on short prefixes; no claim of exact nonlinear posterior closure.
stages: Derive artificial grid variance; compare old grid and continuous transport on the same frozen8-event fixtures against an exact continuous-SOC path sum
Stop local accuracy work when practical query scales are met; preserve residual likelihood/uncertainty differences rather than tuning to machine precision
Benchmark a short causal stream before a long run; implement only necessary execution improvements justified by measurement
Run two prospective four-hour35Hz physical streams: stationary and one monotone Q/R stress change, with informative, weak-use and renewed-excitation phases

Compare uncompressed history, the existing fixed-range16bit log codec, and a binary32 log-weight diagnostic. Continue independent arms after a representation failure; never clip tails or reset evidence to hide it

long_run.phases: First90min informative cycling, next90min zero-current weak use, final60min renewed cycling
long_run.stress: One15% Q loss and15% R0 increase at60min; accelerated model-support stress, not realistic aging-rate calibration
long_run.prior: Shared public three-component SOC prior centered at0.5/0.625/0.75 with0.03 conditional SD; same health, thermal and nuisance supports in both cases
long_run.physical_model: Original C3RC/hysteresis/OCV recurrence, with explicit boundary effective-Q convention and separate thermal laws
long_run.truth_boundary: Generator/scorer only. Inference sees source, index, actualdt, current, measured temperature, voltage and declared noise; no truth-based initialization or correction.
long_run.scope: Whole-stream history/estimation diagnostic on the reduced joint model. Not a new generic callback inside the original rolling optimizer, not firmware qualification.

resources: Record actual live arrays, packed payload estimates, cumulative work and history size. No complete10KiB fit assumed.
